title: strlib: Vowel Report
prompt: Implement public `int count_vowels(const char *s)` (aeiou, case-insensitive) and public `double vowel_ratio(const char *s)` (vowels / length; empty string -> 0.0), backed by a static helper `static int is_vowel_ci(char c)`.

tests.name: empty ratio
tests.hint: Empty string: 0.0, no division by zero.
